web.description: Cryptocurrency hardware maker Ledger has temporarily paused sales  of its products via CryptoBilis following reports of stolen funds linked to devices sold by the reseller. web.title: Critical SonicWall SMA 1000 Flaw Targeted in 135 Exploitation Attempts After Patch
web.description: Threat actors have been observed exploiting a recently disclosed critical security flaw in SonicWall Secure Mobile Access (SMA) 1000 appliances within days of public disclosure.   The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-102255  (CVSS score: 10.0), is a case of pre-authenticated server-side request forgery (SSRF) that could allow a remote attacker "to direct the appliance to issue requests on their behalf and reach internal functionality and perform unauthorized operations."   Patches for the flaw were released by SonicWall on October 6, 2026, with versions 12.4.3-03670 (platform-hotfix) and 12.5.0-03082 (platform-hotfix).   The vulnerability has since started witnessing active exploitation attempts, with first signs detected by threat intelligence firms Defused Cyber  and Previdian  on October 8, 2026.
